allocation: P2-04 boot #3 of 5 — BL-17 live half (owner ruling 2026-11-06, allocation #2)
symptom: `/__p6t6/state` never satisfied `body.rootSessionId === 'session-a5sf-bl17-team'` within the 90 s window; the driver threw `the anchor team never settled; team.create cannot run` before `team.create` was called. All four cases are NOT_REACHED. The Host was healthy (`ok:true`) and alive. Teardown was clean: host pid 55 killed, port 3184 free, home deleted, no orphan.

rootCause.summary: The driver gated on the durable state route on a root that had NO team session yet. `/__p6t6/state` reads `control.listControlState(rootSid)` and `messaging.recoverPendingDeliveries(rootSid)`; on a root with no team session the control service throws `TEAM_RUNTIME_TEAM_SESSION_NOT_FOUND` (documented at packages/runtime/src/plugin/root.ts:3770-3777), so the route answers non-200 until `team.create` has created the team. The gate therefore could never open.
evidence: run log: health=true hostAlive=true at 00:16:43.949Z, then state=false at 00:18:14.107Z (the whole 90 s window), then the throw. team.create was never called (no team.create line in boot3-abort.log).

health answered ok:true, and the p6t6 health body's `ok` is `setupError === null` (packages/tools/harness/plugin.mjs:328-340), so the production Team row's setup did NOT fail. The failure is specific to the state read on a session-less root.
root.ts:3770-3777: 'a root makes listControlState throw TEAM_RUNTIME_TEAM_SESSION_NOT_FOUND'.
the driver did not record the state response body, so the exact status (500 vs 503) is not in the artefact; the code path above is the one that fires on a session-less root with a healthy row.

fix.status: committed on this branch (driver only; no product change)
fix.change: the pre-create state read is now a DIAGNOSTIC that records the status/body and never gates; the state gate runs AFTER team.create and requires `rootSessionId === CREATE_ROOT && teamSession !== null`. The health gate now also records the health body (rootSessionId + setupError).
verifiedHostFree: node run-boot.mjs --plan exits 0 and emits the same row identity + patch layer

budget.retryPolicy: NO retry on the driver's own authority. The shared ledger for this evidence directory holds the intent + boot rows and the driver refuses a second boot (`priorBoots >= 1`). A re-run needs a NEW owner grant bound to the NEW branch HEAD and a fresh evidence directory; the grant's `maxStarts` must cover 1 intent row + 1 boot.
